seeds.charges: "Revolutionary Action" case: organizing mass riots, establishing and leading a criminal organization, incitement, property destruction, and more.
seeds.bio: One of ten anarchists prosecuted in the "Revolutionary Action" case under an "international organized crime" theory. Arrested 12 August 2020. Transferred back to colony No. 20 in April 2025. Has an earlier, separate imprisonment (2010 to 2013).
seeds.statusNotice: A new internal "malicious disobedience" case was opened on 27 February 2025; its outcome is not known.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address confirmed by an April 2025 ABC Belarus report. ABC Belarus withdrew support in 2015 and later reinstated it; read the profile before engaging.

seeds.charges: Attempted act of terrorism by a group (Art. 289.2): alleged attempted arson near the dacha of the Chairman of the Supreme Court.
seeds.bio: Per ABC Belarus's investigation, an entrapment case: a long-time Interior Ministry provocateur operating under a false name cultivated him for months and jointly planned the arson that became the basis of the prosecution. Spent eight months in SIZO-1 Minsk before trial.
seeds.statusNotice: On the KGB "list of persons involved in terrorist activities" since 24 May 2022: forbidden to receive money transfers.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address dated May 2022. Reconfirm before writing.

seeds.charges: "Revolutionary Action" case.
seeds.bio: Detained during a week of arrests in Brest starting 2 March 2021, in the "Revolutionary Action" case.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address from a March 2023 letter-writing list. Reconfirm before writing.

seeds.charges: "Black Nightingales" case: act of terrorism (Art. 289), illegal handling of explosives, desecration of structures.
seeds.bio: Detained 12 January 2024 at age 16, in her final year of school in Minsk, in the "Black Nightingales" case: six teenagers accused of forming an anarchist cell; press accounts describe anti-war and anti-dictatorship graffiti in Baranavichy. Appeal denied 6 February 2026.
seeds.statusNotice: On the KGB "list of terrorists" since February 2026: forbidden to receive money transfers.
seeds.verificationNotes: Facility confirmed by two independent sources (ABC Belarus and Reform.news, May 2026). Reconfirm before writing.

seeds.charges: "Partisan case" / "Black Flag": arson of government vehicles and buildings, illegal weapons and explosives, illegal movement of prohibited substances across the border.
seeds.bio: Arrested with Ihar Alinevich, Dzmitry Rezanovich, and Siarhei Ramanau at the end of October 2020 crossing the Ukrainian border. Convicted 22 December 2021. Reported tortured after detention.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address as reported May 2022. Confirm the current facility before writing.

seeds.sentence: 19 years 9 months (after an added internal case)
seeds.charges: "Partisan case" / "Black Flag", as for Dzmitry Dubouski; a later internal case of malicious disobedience to colony administration.
seeds.bio: Same arrest and trial as Dzmitry Dubouski. Reported subjected to repeated solitary confinement, barred from sports, denied money transfers and visits, and transferred to a cell-type facility for six months (January 2024).
seeds.verificationNotes: Date of this address not confirmed. Reconfirm before writing. The profile URL says "released" but documents him as imprisoned.

seeds.charges: "Pramen" case (the Pramen media collective, designated "extremist").
seeds.bio: Arrested 29 July 2021 in the "Pramen" case; reported tortured at arrest. Born 9 July 1989 in Glubokoe. Studied at the Institute of Informational Technologies and worked as a software developer specializing in rare programming languages. Lived in Amsterdam for almost two years before returning to Belarus in 2020 to take part in the protests.
seeds.verificationNotes: One of the most frequently transferred cases: SIZO-1 Minsk, IK-2 Bobruisk, then ST-8 Zhodino by March 2023. Assume a further move; reconfirm before writing.

seeds.sentence: 7 years, plus an additional year added in early 2026
seeds.charges: "Revolutionary Action" case.
seeds.bio: Detained 2 March 2021 in the same Brest arrest wave as Aleksey Golovko, in the "Revolutionary Action" case.
seeds.statusNotice: An additional year was added to his sentence in early 2026; the revised release date is not known.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address from a March 2023 letter-writing list. Reconfirm before writing.

seeds.bio: Held in the Cárcel de Alta Seguridad, Santiago, Módulo J (3rd floor). Case background not captured; tagged "Marxist" by prisonersolidarity.com.
seeds.verificationNotes: Case details and dates not yet found.

seeds.bio: Named alongside Marcelo Villarroel, Juan Aliste Vega, and Juan Flores Riquelme across communiqués from 2018 to 2021. Took part in a liquid hunger strike from 22 March 2021 demanding repeal of modifications to Decreto Ley 321.
seeds.verificationNotes: Transferred to Rancagua in June 2021; exact current address not confirmed.

seeds.sentence: Prosecutors sought qualified life plus 20 years; sentenced in absentia 2 July 2014
seeds.charges: October 2007 armed robberies of Banco Santander (Valparaíso) and Banco Security, during which a police officer was killed.
seeds.bio: Former member of Mapu Lautaro and a political prisoner already in the 1990s. Arrested in 2009 alongside Marcelo Villarroel and Freddy Fuentevilla. Refused to take part in the 2014 trial, giving statements by video link. Supported but did not join the March 2021 hunger strike, for medical reasons.
seeds.verificationNotes: Transferred to Rancagua in June 2021; noted as receiving medical accommodation. Confirm the exact placement.

seeds.charges: Incendiary attacks on police stations claimed by the Conspiracy of Cells of Fire and the "International Conspiracy of Revenge".
seeds.bio: Arrested 18 September 2014. Has written extensively from prison; a compiled collection of his writings was published by Contra Info. In a 2018 communiqué addressed solidarity to CCF prisoners in Korydallos, Greece.
seeds.verificationNotes: Transferred to Rancagua in June 2021; confirm the exact current facility.

seeds.sentence: 14 years for this case; 46 years in total across convictions
seeds.charges: 2007 Banco Santander (Valparaíso) and Banco Security robberies.
seeds.bio: Arrested 15 March 2008 in Neuquén, Argentina, alongside Freddy Fuentevilla; both deported to Chile in December 2009. Sentenced in absentia 2 July 2014. A 2019 legal change retroactively applying Pinochet-era sentencing rules pushed his parole eligibility to 2036. Has fasted in solidarity with prisoners abroad, including Alfredo Cospito.
seeds.verificationNotes: Placed in Module 33 ("High Security") of La Gonzalina as of July 2024. Reconfirm the cell block before writing.

seeds.charges: 1996 bank robbery in Málaga, Spain, in which two guards were fatally wounded ("4 di Córdoba" case).
seeds.bio: An Italian national held in France. One of the "4 di Córdoba": three Italian anarchists and a fourth participant arrested during a 1996 bank robbery in Málaga. Sentenced to 49 years, among the longest sentences documented in the source.
seeds.verificationNotes: Registration number given as "445097 D5-2G-♱44"; the symbol renders inconsistently across sources. Reconfirm the exact number; the facility address is reliable.

seeds.charges: "Antifa-Ost" proceeding at the Higher Regional Court (OLG) Düsseldorf, part of the Budapest-Komplex case.
seeds.bio: Jena antifascist in pretrial detention (Untersuchungshaft). Moved from JVA Chemnitz to JVA Wuppertal-Ronsdorf on 12 December 2025. Has reported facility harassment in letters and visits (January to February 2026).
seeds.verificationNotes: Surname not given in the source. Confirm cell block and prisoner number via antifa-info.net before writing.

seeds.charges: "Ampelokipoi case", with Marianna Manoura.
seeds.bio: Co-defendant with Marianna Manoura in the "Ampelokipoi case"; the trial was reported as still in progress in April 2026.

seeds.charges: October 2019 armed robbery of a Cholargos gambling shop; a further armed robbery in Thessaloniki in 2021.
seeds.bio: Member of the Organization for Revolutionary Self-Defense (OEA). Sentenced in absentia to 16 years; a fugitive for about two years, issuing communiqués, before capture in 2021.
Long-imprisoned member of the 17 November (17N) organization; his hunger strikes over prison-transfer conditions have been widely covered internationally.

seeds.charges: Membership in the Conspiracy of Cells of Fire; sending parcel bombs to EU officials.
seeds.bio: Arrested 28 October 2017. Has stated that renting the flat and transferring equipment were acts of "revolutionary solidarity" while denying the other charges. In February 2018, on hunger strike, was forcibly removed by special forces for transfer to Larisa, injuring him and triggering a prison-wide uprising. Writes from prison on international anarchist solidarity.
seeds.verificationNotes: Special Wing (Ειδική Πτέρυγα) of Korydallos.

seeds.bio: Held at Malandrino; case details not captured.
Held at Trikala Prison; case details not captured.

seeds.charges: Bank robbery (convicted 2016).
seeds.bio: Convicted in 2016 of bank robbery.
seeds.verificationNotes: Special Wing of Korydallos, per a Czech Anarchist Federation address list. Cross-check against tameio.net before writing.

seeds.charges: "Ampelokipoi case", with Dimitra Zarafeta.
seeds.bio: Co-defendant with Dimitra Zarafeta in the "Ampelokipoi case"; the trial was reported as still in progress in April 2026.
Member of Revolutionary Struggle (Επαναστατικός Αγώνας), alongside Pola Roupa and Kostas Gournas.
seeds.verificationNotes: Special Wing of Korydallos.

seeds.bio: Long-imprisoned member of the 17 November (17N) organization, injured (partial loss of sight and hand function) in a premature bomb detonation that led to the group's exposure.
seeds.verificationNotes: General Korydallos address; the wing was not confirmed.

seeds.bio: Held at Korydallos; case details not captured.
seeds.verificationNotes: Wing not confirmed.

seeds.bio: Held at Malandrino; case details not captured.
Held at Kebon Waru prison, Bandung, one of the "Chaos Star" cluster detained in the August to September 2025 crackdown. Reads English.
seeds.verificationNotes: Source: Dark Nights zine, August 2026, which printed the address as supplied by the person himself; the zine has no URL. A separate source names a different "Adit" (Aditya Dwi Laksana); it is not resolved whether they are the same person.

seeds.bio: Named among the defendants still fighting legal proceedings in a June 2026 communiqué from the Informal Solidarity Network for Political Prisoners of the "Anarchist" Cluster, Surabaya. Reads English.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address supplied by the person himself (August 2026).

seeds.charges: Murder of PSNI Constable Stephen Carroll, 9 March 2009 ("Craigavon Two").
seeds.bio: One half of the "Craigavon Two", convicted 30 March 2012 before a non-jury Diplock court. Supporters point to the single identification witness and the lack of direct evidence. The Criminal Cases Review Commission indicated in late 2025 that it intends to reopen the case. Tagged "Irish Republican socialist" by prisonersolidarity.com.

seeds.charges: Murder of PSNI Constable Stephen Carroll, 9 March 2009 ("Craigavon Two").
seeds.bio: Arrested at 17, the day after the shooting, and convicted at 20 on 30 March 2012 alongside Brendan McConville. Describes himself as a vegan anarchist; a member of the IWW and its prisoner-support arm IWOC, and has spoken about prisoner organizing inside Maghaberry.

Animal-liberation case. The source reports that in 2016 she was diagnosed with cancer and that the prison refused surgery until it was too late; a support-focused letter may be more fitting than a general one.
seeds.verificationNotes: Postcode not captured; confirm before writing.

seeds.bio: Recalled to custody in September 2025 for a licence violation; the underlying case is not given in the source.
seeds.statusNotice: Recalled to custody, not a new sentence.

seeds.bio: Serving a 14-year sentence; case not given in the source.
seeds.verificationNotes: Bristol ABC list snapshot of 10 February 2025; reconfirm current status.

seeds.sentence: 23 years (reclassified 2022); under the 41-bis regime, renewed 30 April 2026
seeds.charges: 2013 shooting of an Ansaldo Nucleare executive; the "Scripta Manent" case; a 2006 bombing reclassified as "strage politica".
seeds.bio: Long-time FAI/FRI militant. Placed under the 41-bis "hard prison" regime in 2022 and went on a 182-day hunger strike against it. The European Court of Human Rights rejected his appeal in September 2025; the regime was renewed for two more years on 30 April 2026, with a complaint pending in Rome.
seeds.statusNotice: 41-bis: mail is censored and monitored; books and CDs already approved by a tribunal were still being contested in mid-2026.

seeds.bio: Held at the C.C. di Siracusa; case details not captured.
seeds.verificationNotes: Single-source address; cross-confirm before writing.

seeds.charges: "Devastazione e saccheggio" for the July 2001 Genoa G8 protests ("Genoa 10"); a separate case over March 2006 clashes in Milan.
seeds.bio: From a small mountain village in Lecco province; raised Catholic, worked with the elderly through a Caritas cooperative before becoming involved in squatting and anarchist organizing. Accused of being a "Black Bloc cell leader" at Genoa 2001 despite never being identified committing any act in the photographic evidence.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address dated 27 March 2014. A strong lead, not a confirmed current fact.

seeds.charges: Arson, evading capture, manufacturing explosive material, and threats; separately, a threatening letter to an assistant prosecutor in Agrigento.
seeds.bio: From Lucca, 64. The underlying attacks targeted the vicinity of a CasaPound headquarters in Florence and an Eni gas distributor. In an April 2023 letter he invited people to write and send books despite obstacles to his correspondence.
seeds.verificationNotes: Ferrara was described by him as a temporary transfer from Milan-Opera in April 2023. Reconfirm before writing.

seeds.sentence: 20 years: 5 in prison, 15 in a strict-regime colony
seeds.charges: Treason and preparing a terrorist act, allegedly as part of a group.
seeds.bio: Anarchist from Novotroitsk, born 1997. Sentenced 7 February 2025; the appeal was upheld unchanged on 19 January 2026.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address confirmed by two fetches of wiki.avtonom.org. Write the full name and "1997 г.р." on the envelope.

seeds.bio: Held at IK-8, Khokhryaki; see the wiki.avtonom.org profile for the case.
seeds.verificationNotes: Partial address; reconfirm via wiki.avtonom.org.

seeds.charges: Alleged leader of "Antifa United" (Art. 282.1).
seeds.bio: Antifascist, born 1999; survived a 2020 neo-Nazi attack. After house arrest, travel restrictions, and eight months in pretrial detention, sentenced to 9 years on 2 February 2026.
seeds.verificationNotes: Pretrial address; he may have been moved to a colony after sentencing. Reconfirm before writing.

seeds.charges: Organizing a terrorist community (Art. 205.4); weapons and explosives possession ("Network" case).
seeds.bio: Born 10 April 1996 in Mokshan, Penza region; a student at Penza State Pedagogical University when arrested by the FSB on 19 October 2017. Has repeatedly alleged torture during the investigation. Published a book of prison writings, "Notes from the Darkness", presented in Paris in March 2026.
seeds.verificationNotes: Returned to IK-17 from a prison hospital in February 2025. Reconfirm given frequent moves.

seeds.charges: Creating an "extremist community", terrorism, and incitement to hatred, tied to 2011 arsons of government buildings.
seeds.bio: Anarcho-communist from Ufa, born 5 September 1990. Sentenced in 2025 over conduct from 2011.

seeds.sentence: 5 years (February 2022); a new case opened March 2026
seeds.charges: "Training for terrorism" (Art. 205.3) and illegal manufacture and possession of explosives ("Kansk teenagers" case); a new case alleging membership in the "A.U.E." organization.
seeds.bio: Born 2005; a minor at the time of the alleged offense in the "Kansk teenagers" case. In March 2026, as his original sentence was ending, a new criminal case was opened against him.
seeds.statusNotice: A second criminal case was opened in March 2026; its outcome is not known.

seeds.sentence: 29 years: 9 in prison, the rest in a strict-regime colony
seeds.charges: Illegal handling of explosives (Art. 222.1), terrorist act (Art. 205 part 2), training for terrorist activity (Art. 205.3): derailing a freight train and a drone attack on the Dyagilevo military airfield.
seeds.bio: Anarchist from Ryazan, born 16 March 1988, a dual Russian and Italian citizen. Detained in late November 2023; has stated publicly that he was tortured. Sentenced 23 May 2025.
seeds.verificationNotes: Arrest date approximate.

seeds.charges: "Justification of terrorism", over alleged comments about Mikhail Zhlobitsky made while watching television with fellow inmates; earlier, vandalism at a United Russia office.
seeds.bio: Mathematician and former Moscow State University postgraduate, born 21 March 1993. Detained again on 4 September 2023 the moment he walked out of his first sentence, and sentenced to four more years. Transferred in April 2026 to IK-18 in Kharp, beyond the Arctic Circle. Has continued mathematics research from prison.
seeds.statusNotice: Transferred beyond the Arctic Circle in April 2026.

seeds.charges: "Incitement to extremism and terrorism"; vandalism for "Death to the regime" graffiti ("Chita Anarchists' Case").
seeds.bio: Born 2003. Detained 31 October 2022 at 19 for graffiti in Chita and suspected of running an anti-war Telegram channel; after an escape attempt, moved to a remand prison. Sentenced 25 April 2024.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address dated August 2024; a sentenced defendant is usually moved to a colony. Write in Russian.

seeds.charges: "Chita Anarchists' Case", with Alexander Snezhkov.
seeds.bio: Born 2006; arrested at 16 for the same graffiti and Telegram channel allegations. Finished tenth grade in pretrial detention. Sentenced 25 April 2024; a vandalism charge was dismissed under the statute of limitations for minors.
seeds.verificationNotes: The most recent of three addresses found; reconfirm before writing. Write in Russian.

seeds.bio: From Penza, born 1994. Trained as a cook-technologist and served in the army as a radio operator before planning to open a fast-food business. In prison since 2018; the case itself is not captured in the source.
seeds.verificationNotes: In custody since 2018 (exact date not given). Write in Russian.

seeds.bio: Born 1988. In custody since 2017, sentenced to 9 years; held at a medical-correctional facility (LIU), which suggests a health-related context.
seeds.verificationNotes: In custody since 2017 (exact date not given). Write in Russian.

seeds.sentence: 3 years 9 months; appeal pending before the Supreme Court
seeds.charges: Assault with a hate aggravator, for assaulting a neo-Nazi during a 2018 antifascist counter-demonstration against the Jusapol police union.
seeds.bio: Anti-fascist anarchist imprisoned since 30 May 2024 pending a Supreme Court appeal.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address confirmed by three independent sources.

seeds.charges: Bank expropriation.
seeds.bio: Anti-authoritarian prisoner across three decades. In April 2018 attempted an escape from a Castellón hospital after surgery. The last remaining imprisoned member of the COLAPSO collective of social prisoners.

seeds.sentence: Imprisoned since 2015 in this stretch; 25 years in total across periods
seeds.bio: Anti-authoritarian prisoner. Helped launch a 2016 proposal for collective struggle inside and outside prisons. Has fasted in solidarity with Alfredo Cospito and with Marcelo Villarroel. His letters from isolation are candid and worth reading before writing.
seeds.statusNotice: His correspondence has been reported as intervened by the prison; letters may be read.

seeds.bio: Connected to the "Virgin Island 3/5" case. Held in unit H19-206.
seeds.verificationNotes: Money only as a money order or cashier's check via "CoreCivic Inmate Trust".

seeds.charges: Several violent felonies arising from a melee at a 6 January 2021 "Stop the Steal" rally outside the New York State Capitol.
seeds.bio: Journalist and artist from Albany, NY, born 26 February 1983, who documented protests and exposed local white-supremacist groups. Ran to help when a Proud Boy tased a Black man at the rally; police arrested three Black activists and later charged him. Found guilty on all charges and sentenced to 20 years.
seeds.verificationNotes: Use the legal name Contompasis and the DIN on the envelope.

seeds.sentence: 80 years, plus 15 for a 1983 escape attempt
seeds.charges: Weapons possession, auto theft, and aiding an escape financed by bank expropriations.
seeds.bio: Anti-authoritarian prisoner since 1979, arrested after freeing a fellow revolutionary from King County Jail in Seattle. Spent seven and a half years in lockdown at Marion after a 1983 escape attempt. Wrote the definition of "political prisoner" that prisonersolidarity.com uses.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address per Prison Radio (2022).

seeds.charges: Maliciously damaging or destroying property used in or affecting interstate commerce (pled guilty January 2025).
seeds.bio: Anarchist and anti-imperialist political prisoner, incarcerated for actions in solidarity with Palestinians during the April 2024 campus encampments. Grew up in the East Bay; ethnic-studies degree from UC Riverside and a PhD in African American studies from Northwestern. Uses they/them pronouns. Birthday 25 April. Welcomes books, zines, and printed news articles.
seeds.verificationNotes: Address per the Anarchist Black Cross Federation, June 2026.

seeds.charges: Conspiracy to commit arson of a federal vehicle.
seeds.bio: Arrested 2 November 2020 in a raid over a string of arsons targeting government property and police vehicles. Wrote a statement from detention, in English and Spanish, on opposition to the Electoral College.
seeds.verificationNotes: Pretrial-era address, very likely outdated. Sources disagree on pronouns (he/they); confirm before writing.
